title: Flex Funnel - Wide Mouth Flexible Funnel with Handle, Automotive Funnels for Engine Oil, Liquid, Diesel, Kerosene,Gasoline (1pcs 5.2" Black)
description:
About this item
1.WIDE OPENING – The wide neck and wide spout allow for rapid filling of fluids without spilling
2.FLEXIBLE SPOUT – The Flexible 8-inch long spout is removable and makes it easy to get in hard to reach areas. The flexible spout is also corrosion resistant
3.MULTIPLE PURPOSE – The U-BCOO Multi-function oil funnel and is built with corrosion resistant, oil resistant, durable plastic. Chemical-resistant polyethylene construction makes this funnel great for Fuel, kerosene, engine oil,Coolant, gasoline
4.CONVENIENT TO USE - U-BCOO Multi-function oil funnel is lightweight, portable and always good-to-go for unexpected vehicular actions! Its non-spill and anti-splash design makes it a general and customary usage for all machinery operations. Easy handling, execution, and worry free!
reviews_5s:
Bought this for running water through my AC drain line and it works very well!Funnel had a long line on it, great quality for the price, good quality for material made withSomehow these things can take a wide stream of liquid and condense it into a very small stream, allowing it to fit through a small opening without splashing all over (thus eliminating practically all loss). Furthermore, the corrugated accordion design permits you to bend or curve the flow of liquid mid-stream, allowing you to direct it to hard-to-reach openings.
Unfortunately I have not been able to verify if these funnels have any blue-tooth capabilities, or if they can connect to wi-fi. The solid state design was a plus and the extremely low energy use was a bonus (no batteries or power cord required).
The two-pack was nice, because it allowed me to keep one for myself and give one to a friend as a gift. He was extremely please with it, as it allowed him to easily fill the gas tank on his boat which was in a tricky area to reach with just the gas can nozzle.
